outcome: Effective dose of oxytocin for preventing uterine atony (ED50 and ED90)
cohort: One hundred pregnant women undergoing cesarean delivery
finding: The study found that the effective dose of oxytocin for preventing uterine atony (ED90) was 9.3 IU/h when co-administered with prophylactic phenylephrine during cesarean delivery, which is higher than the current recommendation.
mod_finding: This study focuses on optimizing oxytocin dosage during cesarean delivery in the context of routine phenylephrine use.
